title.uk: Сталі фрази з прийменниками на роботі 1

focus.en: Fixed phrases where the preposition can't be guessed: in charge of, on behalf of, by mistake, out of stock, on schedule, in confidence, in dollars, upon receipt, by credit card, on average.
focus.uk: Сталі фрази, у яких прийменник не вгадаєш: in charge of, on behalf of, by mistake, out of stock, on schedule, in confidence, in dollars, upon receipt, by credit card, on average.

exercises.text: Who's ___ charge of the petty cash?
I'm writing ___ behalf of Ms. Tremblay.

why.uk: On behalf of = від імені когось.

exercises.text: Sorry, I deleted the file ___ mistake.
This model is currently ___ of stock.
exercises.uk: Цієї моделі зараз немає в наявності.

why.en: Out of stock = none available; in stock = available.
why.uk: Out of stock = немає в наявності; in stock = є.

exercises.text: The project is ___ schedule and under budget.
exercises.uk: Проєкт іде за графіком і не перевищує бюджет.

why.en: On schedule = as planned; ahead of or behind schedule.
why.uk: On schedule = за планом; ahead of або behind schedule — раніше чи з відставанням.

exercises.uk: Будь ласка, сприймайте цю інформацію як конфіденційну.

why.en: In confidence = privately, not to be shared.
why.uk: In confidence = конфіденційно, не для поширення.

exercises.uk: Усі ціни вказано в канадських доларах.

exercises.text: Payment is due ___ receipt of the invoice.

why.en: Upon (or on) receipt = as soon as it's received.
By card, by cheque, by e-Transfer; but in cash.
why.uk: By card, by cheque, by e-Transfer; але in cash.

exercises.text: ___ average, we process 200 invoices a week.
exercises.uk: У середньому ми обробляємо 200 рахунків-фактур на тиждень.
